About me

I'm a graphic designer based in the Philippines. I create visual content that communicates ideas, brands, and emotions.

Every project starts with a question: what should people feel and understand in the first few seconds? I work across posters, logos, and social media, and I enjoy the process as much as the result.

Pumpkin Spice Latte

A poster promoting the Pumpkin Spice Latte for Brew Haven.

The layout highlights the drink as the focal point, with the key selling points of real pumpkin, warm spices, and rich espresso shown as icons along the side.

Details

  • Client: Brew Haven
  • Category: Poster

Brew Haven Landing Page

A landing page for Brew Haven, a coffee shop that invites visitors to slow down.

The hero pairs a warm, dark photo with a serif headline and an accent word in italics, followed by two clear calls to action: see the menu and visit the shop.

Details

  • Client: Brew Haven
  • Category: Web design

The Walking Dead Typography Poster

A typography-led poster study for the film The Walking Dead: The Movie.

Oversized condensed headline type with a distressed texture carries the poster, supported by a centered layout, thin ornamental dividers, and a restrained orange-on-navy palette.

Details

  • Category: Poster
  • Type: Concept / practice piece
